question: After genuinely fixing src/spider/kernel.py distill_parameterized (single-prefix _common_prefix_and_suffix, distinct slot per field-path, field-path relevance filter url/body.*/headers.* only, Jaccard >=0.75 constant-anchor, confidence 0.90) verified by code inspection/unit tests with zero unsubstituted templates, does a narrowed single-family WebArena-Verified v2 pilot (train 3-5 exemplars of one family on resource A, test zero-overlap resource B, >=10 tasks family, family-stratified 5000-bootstrap CIs) achieve EXECUTABLE>=0.75 and binding correctness>=0.90, success margin>=0.12 vs each of B-COLD/B-RAG/B-REPLAY-TERX/B-INSTR, false_accept<=0.10 UNKNOWN in [0.00,0.15] ECE<=0.15, with honest tokens+browser+retrieval+verification cost at f=10?
hypothesis: A corrected kernel-integrated distill_parameterized() fixing three previously falsified bugs — (1) _common_prefix_and_suffix uses single-prefix (common prefix only, not double-prefix truncation) so full resource-B identifiers bind without truncation (e.g., 'SKU-B001' not '001'), (2) field-path relevance filter restricts _extract_varying_values to action-template-relevant paths only (url/path, body.*, headers.*) excluding top-level provenance/state/metadata/evidence noise, (3) structure-similarity Jaccard >=0.75 constant-value anchor check rejects pattern-absence hallucination (E1) — with distinct slot naming per field-path (body.sku -> ${sku}, headers.X-Csrf-Token -> ${csrf_token}, url path segment -> ${resource_id}) via _field_path_to_slot_name/_sanitize_slot at confidence 0.90, durably committed to src/spider/kernel.py and verified by code inspection (grep + sha256 + git diff) + unit tests (B1/B4 regression still PASS, D1 noisy over-param correctly filtered, E1 hallucination rejected, C2 double-prefix full-value, B2/B3/B5 short values), will enable 3-5 exemplars of ONE family on resource A to induce a single parameterized mechanism that on never-observed resource B (zero exact value overlap for all parameterized slots, family hold-out not random split, value_set_A ∩ B = ∅) achieves: (H1) EXECUTABLE >=0.75 and binding correctness >=0.90 with zero unsubstituted ${} templates via deterministic _matches verification; (H2) end-to-end task success >=0.12 absolute above each baseline B-COLD, B-RAG, B-REPLAY-TERX, B-INSTR on same held-out B set when LLM available; (H3) safety false_accept <=0.10, UNKNOWN rate in [0.00,0.15] with ECE <=0.15; (H4) honest amortized cost per success (tokens+browser+retrieval+verification at f=10, distill ~1000 tok added only to SPIDER) measured with 5000 task-bootstrap CIs — demonstrating parameterized inheritance beyond narrow synthetic ceilings (EXP-PRODUCT-33528829801 audit PASS 10/10 single-param, EXP-PRODUCT-33741671686 audit PASS 21/21 harness-only multi-param NOT kernel) in the smallest valid single-family pilot that can change promotion decision without requiring distributed session store or 60-task multi-family census.
falsifier: FALSIFIED if ANY primary gate fails on held-out B via deterministic verification on durable file-based census (not proxy): (F1) M-EXECUTABLE-SPIDER <0.75 (Wilson 95% lower <0.65) or M-BINDING-CORRECT <0.90 (Wilson lower <0.80) or M-UNSUBSTITUTED-TEMPLATES >0 among EXECUTABLE (double-prefix or slot collision persists); (F2) safety M-FALSE-ACCEPT-SPIDER >0.10 or M-UNKNOWN-RATE outside [0.00,0.15] or ECE >0.15; (F3) when LLM substrate available (>=50% trials succeed), SPIDER success M-SUCCESS-SPIDER - max(B-COLD,B-RAG,B-REPLAY-TERX,B-INSTR) <0.12 or family/task bootstrap 95% CI lower <=0.02 or McNemar p>=0.05, i.e., no margin over strongest baseline; (F4) when LLM available, M-AMORTIZED-SAVING-SPIDER-vs-COLD at f=10 <25% or M-COST-RATIO-vs-RAG >0.85 or bootstrap CI crosses 1.0. MIXED if F1 passes but F3 fails (binds correctly but downstream agent/verification fails). MEASUREMENT_INVALID if: (i) kernel fix not durably committed to src/spider/kernel.py (grep distill_parameterized/_common_prefix_and_suffix/_extract_varying_values/_structure_similarity/_is_allowed_path returns 0, sha256 mismatch claimed vs HEAD, git diff base_sha..HEAD empty, or tests/test_kernel_param_inherit.py missing/failing B1/B4/D1/E1/C2/B2/B3/B5), (ii) WebArena-Verified v2 census not durably provisioned (<10 valid tasks after dedup/zero-overlap, or file at data/webarena_verified_v2.json or Docker am1n3e/webarena-verified-shopping@sha256:3e8cb9b945 or static export sha256:d6527566... not loaded, and 404 raw GitHub fallback not counted), (iii) family hold-out leakage (value_set_A ∩ B != ∅), (iv) deterministic verification broken (_matches not exercised via registry required_slots|template_slots/_bind/verify). LLM unavailability alone does NOT invalidate F1/F2 binding gates; it makes F3/F4 NOT_APPLICABLE and reported as unresolved/exploratory per EXPERIMENT_PACKET s9, preserving high-information binding result.

baselines.description: Cold LLM agent with no SPIDER memory: same model/tools/budget (gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 or approved haiku/flash, temp 0.0, seed 42, max 15 steps, 4096 tokens, Playwright chromium headless navigate/click/fill/type/select/goBack/observe) on identical held-out B tasks, same prompt without retrieved mechanisms. Cost = measured LLM input+output tokens (API usage) + browser calls (count+ms) + latency per task. No retrieval, no verification shortcut, no distill. Upper-bound full-re-exploration cost.
baselines.expected: Success lower than SPIDER on held-out B where B identifiers never observed; cost flat vs novelty; denominator for amortized saving. SPIDER expected +0.12 success and >=25% amortized cheaper at f=10 if LLM available.

baselines.description: Semantic retrieval / RAG over prior trajectories: same LLM retrieves nearest successful trajectory from training set A by Jaccard over intent+state keywords (threshold 0.30) and replays verbatim without parameter induction via same deterministic _matches verification. Retrieval cost 200 tok + measured ms per task. If retrieved identifiers match test B at verification, reuse at 0 LLM tokens for matching prefix; otherwise fallback to COLD exploration for mismatched steps. Hit/miss measured directly; single-family hold-out ensures many misses on B (exact-copy 0.0781). Same verification logic as SPIDER.
baselines.expected: Hit_rate ~0.05-0.10 on held-out B (duplication 0.9479 is parameterized reuse, exact-copy 0.0781, so literal hit rare); overall success << SPIDER without parameterization. SPIDER expected success >= RAG+0.12 and cost <=0.85x RAG amortized when LLM available.

baselines.description: 0-token exact replay (TERX/BrowserBash) with LLM fallback: if test task's full parameterized identifier sequence exactly equals a training trajectory A (exact string equality on action_template including path+body+headers, no parameterization), replay at 0 LLM tokens +1 verification browser call (50 tok, 90ms) +1 browser execution; otherwise replay fails deterministic verification and falls back to COLD LLM exploration for full task. Hit cost = 50 tok verification only; miss cost = COLD cost. Hit_rate measured inside compared set (expected ~0.0 on held-out B, ~1.0 on same-resource PC).
baselines.expected: Hit_rate ~0.0 on held-out B by design (B never observed) -> cost = COLD. SPIDER expected cheaper than REPLAY on held-out where REPLAY misses and within 2x of REPLAY on same-resource control where REPLAY hits at 50 tok.

baselines.description: Site-specific hand-authored instructions baseline: same LLM supplied with natural-language site instructions (e.g., WebArena shopping add_to_cart procedure) but no parameterized mechanism or retrieval. Instruction tokens 200 amortized over f=10 (20 tok/task). Cost = instruction amortized + full identifier-specific steps (agent must discover B identifiers). Tests whether instructions alone achieve transfer without param slots.
baselines.expected: Cost slightly below COLD but above SPIDER; success below SPIDER on multi-param families. SPIDER expected to beat INSTR by >=0.10 success and >=15% amortized cost when LLM available.

baselines.description: Literal (zero-parameter) mechanism replay: distill literal mechanisms via current kernel distill() without parameter induction and attempt resolve on B via exact registry match through same required_slots|template_slots/_bind/verify path. Tests parameterization necessity (literal should fail on unseen B). Same verification. Operates without LLM.
baselines.expected: Success ~0.0 on held-out B, EXECUTABLE 0.0, confirming literal cannot handle novelty. Validates any SPIDER success is due to param slots not trivial match. If B-LITERAL success >0.15, family hold-out leakage suspect.

positive_control.description: Two positive controls exercising real pipeline on same substrate without LLM: (PC1) Same-resource literal hit: training resource A mechanism replayed on same resource A with identical identifiers must achieve hit_rate 1.0 via B-REPLAY-TERX pipeline with 0 LLM tokens +1 browser verification call (50 tok) and success 1.0; validates substrate can measure 0-cost case and deterministic verification works. (PC2) Multi-param regression on same A: distill_parameterized on 3-5 A observations of the pilot family (path+body+headers varying, same src/spider/kernel.py code as SPIDER) tested on same A via actual registry required_slots|template_slots/_bind/verify must resolve EXECUTABLE 1.0, binding correctness 1.0, success >=0.90 (if LLM available; else binding 1.0 suffices), zero templates. Confirms induction works before testing generalization to B. Both use measured verification outcomes, not forced constants. Failure -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID not falsification.
positive_control.expected_behavior: PC1: B-REPLAY same-A cost 50 tok, 1 browser call, success 1.0, hit_rate 1.0, B-LITERAL same-A EXECUTABLE 1.0. PC2: multi-param same-A EXECUTABLE 1.0, binding 1.0, zero templates, success >=0.90 (or binding gate alone if LLM unavailable). Thresholds frozen; task-bootstrap not needed for PCs (n=3-7).

null_control.description: Two null controls via real registry/_bind/verify semantics without LLM: (NC1) Shuffled slot mapping: randomly permute learned parameter_slots -> identifier binding (e.g., swap ${sku} with ${resource_id}) before SPIDER resolve on same held-out B tasks via actual registry/_bind/verify; each task incurs real retrieval+verify+fallback costs via verification outcomes (mismatched binds fail verification and trigger fallback, introducing variability). Expected binding correctness <0.50, success <= B-COLD, false_accept elevated >=0.25, proving transfer requires correct parameterization. (NC2) Random retrieval: registry returns random entry instead of ranked match, UNKNOWN disabled, via actual ranking path; expected false_accept >=0.30 or success <= B-COLD. Both go through actual binding/verification so they CAN fail the expected null pattern if mapping truly matters (not guaranteed flat).
null_control.expected_behavior: NC1 shuffled binding correctness <0.50, success <= B-COLD +0.05, false_accept >=0.25. NC2 random false_accept >=0.30 or success <= B-COLD. If NC1 success >= SPIDER -0.05 on deterministic binding gate, observed SPIDER effect is spurious (task difficulty confounded) -> measurement invalid for param-inherit claim.

measurement_validity: 1. Durable kernel fix in src/spider/kernel.py (not harness copy): single-prefix _common_prefix_and_suffix, field-path relevance filter _is_allowed_path/_extract_varying_values restricted to url/path, body.*, headers.* only, structure-similarity Jaccard >=0.75 constant-anchor via _structure_similarity, distinct slot naming per field-path via _field_path_to_slot_name/_sanitize_slot, confidence 0.90. Verified by code inspection (grep distill_parameterized/_common_prefix_and_suffix/Jaccard/_is_allowed_path/_extract_varying_values/_structure_similarity returns >=1 hit), sha256 of src/spider/kernel.py matches claimed hash in provenance.json, git diff base_sha..HEAD nonempty for src/spider/kernel.py, and unit tests tests/test_kernel_param_inherit.py exist and pass B1/B4 regression, D1 noisy over-param filtered, E1 hallucination rejected, C2 full-value user-4, B2/B3/B5 short values. If any gate fails -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID before outcome measurement.

2. File-based WebArena-Verified v2 census for single-family pilot without requiring distributed infra: load from durable source data/webarena_verified_v2.json or Docker image am1n3e/webarena-verified-shopping@sha256:3e8cb9b945 or verified static export sha256:d65275660814663375028e9017e1f929e3c38321041b125795e2713b52243d30 (or successor pinned hash); 404 raw GitHub URLs alone do not count as census_verified. Deduplicate by template+intent hash; require >=1 family with >=10 tasks total, with >=3 exemplars in pool A and >=7 in pool B (or 5+5) with disjoint identifiers (SKU, store, user, issue IDs). Training uses 3-5 exemplars from A only; test B values have zero exact value overlap with A for all parameterized slots (verified by value set intersection = 0, logged via SHA256 of sorted value sets). Pilot family is add_to_cart (14 tasks: 7 A SKU-A001..A007, 7 B SKU-B001..B007) per synthetic census or equivalent real family with >=10 tasks. Minimum 10 valid B tasks required for decision (Wilson half-width ~0.22 at 10); target 14 B if budget allows. Census duplication/exact_copy/param_task statistics logged but not gating; claim ceiling bounded to single-family file-based census.

3. Registry/resolve/verify exercised via real src/spider/kernel.py path: required_slots = set(parameter_slots) | _template_slots(action_template); freshness gating behavioral_score 0.25 and confidence gating <0.80 -> UNKNOWN abstention; if UNKNOWN -> fallback to COLD cost (if LLM available) else counted as abstention; if EXECUTABLE -> bound_action = _bind(action_template, params) via actual _bind and deterministic postcondition verification (_matches on observed state after execution against next_state or DOM, not LLM-as-judge). Code path must be src/spider/kernel.py verified by audit diff + sha256, not research/harness copy.

4. Baselines executed on identical held-out B set with identical deterministic verification logic. B-RAG Jaccard TAU=0.30 and verification-gated; B-REPLAY exact action_template string equality; B-INSTR instruction tokens correctly amortized as 200/f; B-LITERAL uses literal kernel distill without slots via same registry path. When LLM available, all LLM baselines use same model/tools/budget (gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 or approved haiku/flash, temp 0.0, seed 42, max 15 steps, 4096 tokens, Playwright chromium headless) and identical budget; costs measured in same units (tokens, ms, calls). When LLM unavailable, LLM baselines reported as NOT_APPLICABLE (not zero) and binding gate (B-LITERAL) remains primary baseline proving parameterization necessity.

5. Honest end-to-end cost accounting with amortized maintenance (LLM-available branch): per-task cost measured as live LLM input+output tokens via API usage (not bijective formula 250+500*10*novelty), browser calls (count+wall ms), retrieval tokens/latency (200 tok+measured ms if SPIDER/RAG), verification tokens/latency (50 tok+measured ms if EXECUTABLE attempted), repair tokens/calls if verification fails (1 LLM step). Distill cost ~1000 tok amortized over f=10 added ONLY to SPIDER; instruction 200 tok amortized as 200/f for INSTR only. Report raw per-task and amortized f=1,10,100 with task-bootstrap 5000 resamples (task as resampling unit for single-family, seed 42) for CI on cost ratios/success differences, plus deterministic verification. When LLM unavailable, cost metrics reported as null with reason api_key_absent and binding gate remains valid.

6. Verification and calibration without LLM: verification is deterministic postcondition _matches on expected next_state/DOM after binding (not LLM-as-judge). False_accept measured as bound_action passes verification but is incorrect per oracle (value mismatch) or literal would have failed; UNKNOWN abstention measured per binding attempt; ECE (expected calibration error) for confidence vs binding success with 10 bins threshold 0.15 where measurable. Freshness guard behavioral_score exercised where available; distributed session store not required for this single-family gate.

7. Statistics honoring task structure: primary binding correctness and EXECUTABLE rate use Wilson 95% CI (task as independent unit for single-family; family-stratified not applicable for single-family but task-bootstrap 5000 resamples seed 42 for CI on differences). LLM success comparison (when available) uses paired McNemar or task-bootstrap (5000, seed 42) two-sided 95% CI; power >0.80 to detect 0.12 delta at n>=10 per condition requires noting limited power (at n=14, power ~0.45 for 0.12 delta — therefore binding gate is primary discriminating test; success margin at n=14 is exploratory and requires replication to 60-task multi-family for full power). No degenerate Spearman with ties; trajectory independence not assumed beyond task level. Significance requires both primary binding gate and (if LLM available) success margin.

8. Prereg frozen before any outcome-bearing measurement on held-out B; code (src/spider/kernel.py patch), fixtures (pilot_family.json), model version (if LLM used), census hash, proxy constants, thresholds hashed in freeze.json. Deterministic seeds (PYTHONHASHSEED=0, random.seed 42, LLM seed 42 if used), all hashes logged. Raw evidence preserved: per-task CSV with tokens/calls/latency/success/bound_action/verification/UNKNOWN/false_accept/ECE bins where LLM available else binding-only CSV; registry JSON with slots/templates; cost_config JSON; census verification log (hash, duplication, pool A/B value sets, zero-overlap SHA256); provenance.json with commits, run ids, dataset hashes, census verification, kernel sha256+grep hits+git diff.
decision_rule: SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST (binding gate) requires ALL of (C1)-(C3) plus (C5) measured via deterministic _matches verification on durable file-based single-family census (not proxy): (C1) M-EXECUTABLE-SPIDER >=0.75 (Wilson 95% lower >=0.65) and M-BINDING-CORRECT >=0.90 (Wilson lower >=0.80) among EXECUTABLE with M-UNSUBSTITUTED-TEMPLATES =0 (no ${} remains); (C2) safety S-SAFETY: M-FALSE-ACCEPT-SPIDER <=0.10 (Wilson upper <=0.20) and M-UNKNOWN-RATE-SPIDER in [0.00,0.15] on valid B and B-LITERAL success <=0.15 on same B (confirming param necessity) and PC-B-LITERAL-EXPECTED fail validated; (C3) calibration: UNKNOWN cases have confidence <0.80 or required_slots missing where applicable, ECE <=0.15 with 10 bins, verification AUROC >=0.75 where measurable or contamination <0.10 via unrelated mechanisms; (C5) controls: PC1 same-A literal hit_rate 1.0 cost 50 tok success 1.0 PASS and PC2 multi-param same-A EXECUTABLE 1.0 binding 1.0 zero templates success >=0.90 if LLM available else binding 1.0 suffices PASS; NC1 shuffled binding correctness <0.50 and NC2 random false_accept >=0.30 or success <= B-COLD when measured. FULL SURVIVES (economics) additionally requires (C4) when LLM available: M-SUCCESS-SPIDER >=0.65 and > B-COLD by >=0.12 and > B-RAG by >=0.12 and > B-REPLAY-TERX by >=0.12 and > B-INSTR by >=0.10 with task-bootstrap 95% CI lower >0.02 and McNemar p<0.05, and E-ECON: M-AMORTIZED-SAVING-SPIDER-vs-COLD >=25% at f=10 (cost per success) with bootstrap CI not crossing 1.0 and M-COST-RATIO-RAG <=0.85 with CI upper <1.0. FALSIFIED if any C1-C2 fails on valid file-based substrate (excluding PC/NC substrate failures which are MEASUREMENT_INVALID) or if LLM available and C4 fails (no margin or no economics). MIXED if C1 passes but C4 fails when LLM available (binds correctly but agent fails downstream). MEASUREMENT_INVALID if: kernel not durably committed, <10 valid B tasks after dedup/zero-overlap, census not durably verified, verification broken, or LLM unavailable for C4 (then C4 reported as NOT_APPLICABLE/exploratory, primary C1-C3 binding verdict still valid and high-information per Director mandate). All thresholds frozen; primary outcome is C1 binding correctness + zero templates; secondary outcome is C4 success margin+economics when LLM substrate present.
product_consequence_positive: If SURVIVES (binding gate) or FULL SURVIVES: C-PARAM-INHERIT advances from EXPERIMENTAL (narrow synthetic ceilings: 10/10 single-param 5.42% saving EXP-PRODUCT-33528829801, 21/21 harness-only multi-param EXP-PRODUCT-33741671686 NOT kernel, 42+ prior attempts KERNEL-INTEGRATION-FALSIFIED/PARTIAL, last 5 Graph pilots MEASUREMENT_INVALID due to transient kernel/fabricated provenance/synthetic census mismatch) to VALIDATED at bounded single-family file-based ceiling (one family path+body+headers, deterministic _matches, zero templates, EXECUTABLE>=0.75 binding>=0.90). Establishes first durable measurement that corrected distill_parameterized (single-prefix, field-path filter, Jaccard >=0.75 distinct slots conf 0.90) in src/spider/kernel.py generalizes A->B with zero unsubstituted templates and honest verification. If FULL SURVIVES additionally (LLM available, success +0.12 vs each baseline, economics >=25% at f=10), unblocks C-LLM-INHERIT/C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY/C-PRODUCT-ECON scale-up to 10-family (60 tasks) and Docker full-DOM hosting; informs productization vs TERX 0-token replay dominance (SPIDER wins where replay misses). Authorizes kernel promotion of distill_parameterized (promotion_ready true, pending kernel tests). No immediate SHIPPED; requires replication on >=10 families and freshness hardening before SHIPPED.
product_consequence_negative: If FALSIFIED on binding gate (F1/F2): C-PARAM-INHERIT remains EXPERIMENTAL at narrow synthetic ceiling; for this single-family setting parameterized transfer is falsified (mechanism binds incorrectly or leaves templates, double-prefix/Jaccard/field-filter insufficient despite durable src patch). Product must NOT promote kernel fix as VALIDATED; next Graph pulse should abandon single-family WebArena shopping pilot and pivot to orthogonal high-upside per Director portfolio (e.g., Intel within-store transfer, Frontier workflow compilation, or Runtime distributed freshness) rather than enlarging to 10-family before binding gate passes. If MIXED (binds but LLM success margin fails when LLM available): mechanism binds correctly but downstream agent/verification fails -> investigate Playwright execution or agent prompt, not just induction. If LLM-dependent F4 fails while binding passes: supports caching-vs-generalization tension (exact replay/RAG dominates where reusable) but primary binding gate surviving still justifies kernel promotion as VALIDATED-narrow. If MEASUREMENT_INVALID due to undurable kernel, <10 tasks, census 404, or verification broken, priority is fixing src/spider/kernel.py durable integration (single-prefix, field-filter, Jaccard distinct slots) and file-based census provisioning via Docker/static export before re-testing economics; LLM unavailability alone keeps binding gate informative and does NOT falsify C-PARAM-INHERIT. Negative still high information: definitively isolates whether src kernel fix is sufficient for EXECUTABLE/binding before spending LLM budget on 60-task multi-family.
estimated_cost: File-based single-family pilot without LLM: ~0 API cost, ~5 min wall-clock on GitHub Actions (census load, kernel unit tests 16 tests, distill 3-5 A -> 1 mechanism, resolve+verify 10-14 B tasks via deterministic _matches, 5000 bootstrap, Wilson CIs). With LLM (optional branch): 10-14 B tasks x5 conditions (SPIDER/COLD/RAG/REPLAY/INSTR) =50-70 runs +7 PC +14 NC =71-91 runs; each run 8-12 LLM calls x ~1500 tokens avg =12k-18k tokens ~$0.04-$0.08 per run at gpt-4o-mini pricing ($0.15/1M in, $0.60/1M out) => $3-$7 total (+ negligible retrieval/verification). Wall-clock ~15-25 min with 4-way batching. Storage: per-task CSV ~91 rows, registry JSON, cost_config, census verification log, kernel sha+grep+diff, provenance. Deterministic seeds, all hashes logged.
expected_information_gain: HIGH: First durable valid test of SPIDER's central product promise after 42+ C-PARAM-INHERIT attempts with last 5 pilots MEASUREMENT_INVALID due to transient kernel (HEAD sha 46929b3a vs claimed b8c3f7..., grep 0 hits, test file absent) and synthetic census mismatch (275 tasks dup 0.8182 vs target 0.9479, 7<10 tasks) and no LLM keys. Isolates the binding prerequisite gate that previous 60-task multi-family pilots could not reach: if EXECUTABLE/binding fails with zero templates, product economics cannot succeed regardless of freshness gating (Director comparative reasoning) — so single-family pilot can FALSIFY centralized parameterization before 60-task spend. Either a positive (EXECUTABLE>=0.75 binding>=0.90 zero templates with durable src fix, deterministic verification, false_accept<=0.10, UNKNOWN/ECE calibrated) or a valid negative (no executable/binding on never-observed B where duplication 0.9479 requires genuine parameterization, exact-copy 0.0781) decisively changes promotion decision: (1) whether C-PARAM-INHERIT advances EXPERIMENTAL->VALIDATED-narrow and justifies kernel promotion despite prior KERNEL-INTEGRATION-FALSIFIED, (2) whether to scale to 10-family 60-task multi-family and unblock C-LLM-INHERIT/C-PRODUCT-ECON vs pivoting Graph to orthogonal high-upside, (3) whether distinct-slot field-path induction solves double-prefix (user-4) and hallucination (E1) at src integration level. Resolves starved-claim bottleneck (0/60 recent Graph valid) and tunnel flags with minimal spend (10 vs 60 tasks) and without distributed session-store dependency.
